facts.text: I want to create a web portal project named Smart Reservation System for Multiple Venues.
The Smart Reservation System for Multiple Venues should develop a reservation system for hotels, restaurants, and entertainment venues.
The system should allow users to search for available spaces.
The system should allow users to make bookings.
The system should allow users to manage their reservations.
The system should include payment processing features.
The system should include event scheduling features.
The system should include user feedback features.
The project will be a microservices web application.
The front end should use Angular and Bootstrap.
The backend should use Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Eureka.
User data should be stored in MySQL.
A distributed database like Cassandra could be used to store reservation-related data such as user information, reservation details, and availability across multiple hotels.
The system should use a GraphQL API for hotel search functionality.
The system should use a REST API for users and a gateway.
API testing should use MuleSoft.
The project should include a machine learning microservice using TensorFlow in Java.
The CI/CD code should be hosted on GitHub.
The build process should use Maven.
The packaging process should use Docker.
Docker images should be published as part of the pipeline.
Deployment should be done with Jenkins.
The project should use the Scrum methodology.
The project should be composed of 5 sprints.
Each sprint should be one week.
There are only two developers on the project.
